meaning: Be the reason they hire from the Philippines.
tagline: Be the reason they hire from the Philippines. A free, path-based site for Filipinos building an online career.
mission: Hire From PH is built on one idea: the people companies hire from the Philippines should be the ones worth hiring anywhere. Everything here is free to read, and every figure carries a link to its source.

standard.title: We don't hand you files. We make you resourceful.
standard.body: Anyone can give you a resume template. It makes you look like every other applicant, and it stops helping the moment the job is different. Hire From PH teaches you the anatomy, the rules, and the judgment, then you build your own, from a blank page, for any situation. That skill is the actual asset, and no one can take it off you.

principles.title: Method over material
principles.desc: Every lab teaches how the thing is built and why, never a file to download and rename.

principles.title: You build it, you own it
principles.desc: The artifact you leave with is written in your words, from your situation, so you can rebuild it anywhere.

principles.title: Independence is the goal
principles.desc: The platform succeeds when you no longer need it; every page builds toward that.

footer.honesty: Independent and non-commercial. Nothing on this site is for sale, and no page asks for your email.
footer.note: Pay figures and market data are cited to their sources, and every one of them is an estimate rather than a promise.
